cohort: Infants with indirect hyperbilirubinemia who were treated with phototherapy in the neonate intermediate unit at Dr. Soetomo Hospital over 6 months.
finding: The onset of jaundice within 3 days of birth was identified as a significant risk factor for rebound hyperbilirubinemia after phototherapy.
mod_finding: Infants born via cesarean section had a higher incidence of rebound hyperbilirubinemia (67%), although this was not statistically significant.
